annotations.annotation_text: Page 218 opens Book 2, Chapter 1 ("The Mime of Mick, Nick and the Maggies") during the Age of Heroes phase. This passage continues the children's games and pantomime on the green, Chuff vs. Glugg, the twenty-eight Rainbow Girls, the Angelus bell, featuring Shem (Glugg), Shaun (Chuff), Issy, the Maggies. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
